churches.assessment: First Presbyterian Church of Orlando is a 135+ year historic congregation that voted to join the Evangelical Presbyterian Church (EPC) in 2012, departing the progressive PCUSA. Rev. Dr. David D. Swanson (M.Div., Austin Presbyterian Theological Seminary) has served as Senior Pastor for over 20 years. Located at 106 E Church Street in downtown Orlando, the church maintains a visible downtown ministry presence. The EPC is Westminster-lite — confessionally Reformed but more moderate than the PCA on some issues, notably allowing presbyteries to set their own policy on women as elders. For green-eligibility, verify the local elder board composition and the Central Florida Presbytery stance. Overall a solidly orthodox Reformed option in central Florida.

churches.assessment: Idlewild Baptist Church is a large SBC congregation in the Tampa/Lutz area. Whitten retired and joined NAMB as national director of pastoral leadership. New pastoral leadership should be evaluated. SBC-affiliated with strong missions DNA.
churches.denomination_detail: Southern Baptist Convention — BFM2000; Aponte came from International Mission Board.
churches.gender_detail: SBC BFM2000 complementarian.

churches.name: Idlewild Baptist Church
churches.services: Sunday 9:15 AM & 11:00 AM (ASL, closed captioning, Spanish translation)

score_notes.christology: Affirms Trinity, Christ's deity, substitutionary atonement, literal bodily return — orthodox evangelical Christology.
score_notes.scripture: Affirms 'the Bible as the inspired Word of God' — evangelical inerrancy framing.
score_notes.gender: No women in senior pastor or primary teaching pastor roles per staff page. Women serve in supportive roles (Director of Women's Ministry, Director of Communications). Complementarian in practice — yellow (not green because explicit male-eldership framing not articulated on page fetched).
score_notes.leadership: Large pastoral team with Dr. Edgar Aponte as senior pastor; IMB and Southeastern Seminary connections.
score_notes.soteriology: Affirms substitutionary atonement, salvation exclusively through Christ, eternal security, believer's baptism — sola fide Baptist soteriology.
score_notes.cultural: 'Separation of church and state, but not separation of God and government' — civic-engagement framing, conservative-evangelical stance.
score_notes.preaching: Homepage references 'RECENT TEACHINGS' and 'Watch the latest sermon' but does not characterize approach as expository. Yellow stands.
score_notes.mission: SBC churches give through Cooperative Program; Great Commission emphasis standard.
score_notes.mens_discipleship: R44 refetch: Men's ministry link confirmed, routing to https://www.idlewildlegacy.com/men/ — dedicated men's track exists. Keep yellow pending programmatic detail review (upgrade candidate on next audit).
score_notes.denominational: About page and homepage do not explicitly confirm SBC affiliation despite directory listing. Yellow stands pending /about verification.

churches.assessment: Riverside Church at Park & King is a Florida-historical case of SBC departure over both LGBTQ+ affirmation and (subsequently) female pastoral leadership. The church separated from the Southern Baptist Convention in 2009 after then-FL Baptist Convention Executive Director John Sullivan challenged the church's LGBTQ+ acceptance; today the church is openly affirming, lists female pastoral leadership (Pastor Courtney, Rev. Clair), and is a member of the Association of Welcoming and Affirming Baptists, the Alliance of Baptists, and the Cooperative Baptist Fellowship. Pre-2020 departure date noted; included as a FL SBC drift datapoint because it remains widely cross-listed in legacy SBC directories and demonstrates the FL Baptist Convention's enforcement pattern that later led to the 2023 Freedom Church and 2026 Crossing Church disfellowshipments.
churches.gender_detail: Female pastoral leadership documented (Pastor Courtney, Rev. Clair) on current 2025-2026 social channels. Specific titles (Senior, Associate, Co-Pastor) not crisply listed on current site — needs human triage to confirm titles and full names.
churches.denomination_detail: SBC departure documented to 2009 (Wikipedia, FL Baptist Convention historical reporting). Now in Alliance of Baptists, CBF, and AWAB. The 2009 date pre-dates this sweep's post-2020 cutoff but is included for completeness because the church is still searchable as 'Riverside Baptist Church' in legacy SBC contexts.
churches.enrichment_notes: 2009 SBC departure pre-dates the post-2020 sweep cutoff. Pastor names (Courtney, Clair) gleaned from current Facebook posts and Instagram; full names and crisp titles need human verification before final publication. Address verified at 2650 Park St, Jacksonville FL 32204.
